info.title: Vynel API
info.description: Vynel — desktop AI assistant for non-technical knowledge workers. Phase 1 ships locally; single-user.

404.description: Workspace not found.

get.summary: List indexed documents for the active workspace.

x-mcp.name: list_knowledge_documents
x-mcp.description: List indexed knowledge documents for the active workspace (owner-scoped — only the authenticated user's documents). Supports filtering by documentKind (markdown / plain-text / pdf / docx / html / csv / json), or by an exact `path` (workspace-relative) to fetch the single matching document. Cursor-paginated by (indexedAt DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC). Read-only.

404.description: Knowledge document not found in this workspace.

get.summary: Get one knowledge document + its chunks (workspace-scoped).

x-mcp.name: get_knowledge_document
x-mcp.description: Get one knowledge document by id, along with its parsed chunks. Owner-scoped — returns 404 if the document does not belong to the active workspace. The chunks carry character offsets + token estimates; the chunkText is the parsed-and-normalized content used for both FTS and semantic search. Read-only.

404.description: Workspace not found.

get.summary: Search knowledge chunks (FTS5, semantic, or hybrid).

x-mcp.name: search_knowledge
x-mcp.description: Search the workspace's indexed documents by text query. Mode: "fts" (FTS5 keyword), "semantic" (sqlite-vec cosine over MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings), or "hybrid" (default; Reciprocal Rank Fusion k=60). Returns up to `limit` matching chunks with FTS snippet (literal <mark> tokens) + scores. Optional documentKindFilter is a comma-separated list of document kinds to restrict to. Owner-scoped. Read-only.

404.description: Workspace not found.

get.summary: Get the indexer status for the active workspace.

x-mcp.name: get_indexer_status
x-mcp.description: Return the indexer status for the active workspace: total documents, per-parse-state counts (parsed / pending / parsing / failed / skipped), the count of chunks awaiting embedding generation, and the most recent indexed-at timestamp. Read-only.

404.description: Workspace not found.

post.summary: Force-reindex every document in the active workspace.

200.description: { source: SerializedKnowledgeSource, indexed: { indexedCount, skippedCount, failedCount } }.

404.description: Workspace not found.

post.summary: Register a directory to index, at workspace or global scope.

x-mcp.name: add_to_knowledge
x-mcp.description: Add a directory to the knowledge base so its files are indexed for search. `absolutePath` is the directory on disk; `scope` is "workspace" (indexed for the active workspace) or "global" (indexed for the user across all workspaces). Registers the source, starts watching it for changes, and indexes its current files. Mutating.

404.description: Workspace not found.

get.summary: List registered knowledge sources (the workspace's + the user's global sources).

x-mcp.name: list_knowledge_sources
x-mcp.description: List the registered knowledge sources in scope for the active workspace: the workspace's own sources plus the user's global sources. Each carries its absolute path, scope, and timestamps. Read-only.

404.description: Workspace not found.

delete.summary: Remove a registered knowledge source (stops watching; purges its docs + chunks).

x-mcp.name: remove_knowledge_source
x-mcp.description: Remove a registered knowledge source by id. Stops watching its directory and purges its indexed documents + chunks (cascade). Idempotent — removing an unknown id is a no-op. Mutating.

get.summary: List the Verified-skill catalog (available to install).

x-mcp.name: list_available_skills
x-mcp.description: List the Verified-skill catalog the user can install (read-only). Returns each skill's id, display name, one-line description, category, recommended scope, and settings schema. Use this when the user asks what skills exist or which to install. Does NOT modify state.

200.description: Each installed skill joined with its catalog definition (if any) + resolved settings.

404.description: Workspace not found.

get.summary: List skills installed in this user+workspace context.

x-mcp.name: list_installed_skills
x-mcp.description: List skills installed in the current user+workspace context (owner-scoped). Returns the union of user-scope (available across every workspace) + workspace-scope (this workspace only) entries, each with version, scope, isEnabled flag, install health, and resolved settings. Read-only — use this to know what skills the agent currently has available, not to install them.

post.summary: Disable an installed skill — removes files from disk; preserves row + settings.

200.description: The resolved settings (defaults merged with overrides).
